gaps.lead: I rarely drink coffee in the evening.
gaps.explanation: be (not) used to something = (not) accustomed to it.

gaps.lead: I can't wait for the holidays to start.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: the 'to' is a preposition.

gaps.lead: 'I have never lied to the press,' the minister said.
gaps.explanation: deny + -ing (ever strengthens the denial): denied ever lying.

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: He had just sat down when the phone rang.
gaps.explanation: No sooner had + subject + participle … than…

gaps.lead: You didn't tell me about the meeting, and you should have.
gaps.sentence: You really ___ me about the meeting.
gaps.explanation: ought to have + participle = should have done (but didn't).
